mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions that precede stronger corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 2.0% signals active monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) indicates supply chain disruptions that reduce corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases and unemployment rate decreases signal an overheating economy that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.0%) leads to profit-taking and rising rate expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.0%), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1300 thousand units signals strong residential construction activity that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1300, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
